title: extension.manifest@1
description: What a package declares, in the one package envelope (package.envelope@1's fields at the root): the access words it uses, its panels and the media each uses, the output interfaces it provides and uses (each pinned to a minor), the shipped pieces it replaces, and the names it adds: event kinds, store kinds, check kinds, codes, notice kinds and actions, each ext.<plugin>.<name> unless the piece replaces the shipped piece of that name. The fields the later issues bring (conflicts, contract versions, secrets, sources, MCP commands, jobs, an out-of-process host, run-as-you, handoff, guards, lease kinds, hook context templates) arrive with their fixtures. The rules the node types can't write, a medium used without its access word and a name without its prefix, are checkManifest's.

id.description: owner/name: exactly one slash between two names. The name is the plug-in the ext.<plugin>. prefix names.

version.description: The package's semantic version: major.minor.patch, then a pre-release and build metadata as semver 2.0.0 writes them.

digest.description: The frozen digest of the package's contents, naming its algorithm.

publisher_key.description: The key the publisher signed the package with, when it is signed.

items.description: One access word, from access@1's closed list; notices, schedules and secrets are blocks, not words, so each fails here.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of access that adds a word

area.description: Where the panel sits: the sidebar, the home screen, a tab in any panel or the line.

x-closure.closed: each value is a place the app shell lays out, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

items.description: A medium the panel uses, each only with its access word.

x-closure.closed: each value is a medium the device and media gate guards, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

x-closure.closed: each value is an output kind the hub wires, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

minor.description: The interface's minor this package provides.

interface.description: The output interface used, name@major, never a piece.

minor.description: The minor the use was built against; the hub serves it at that minor.

digest.description: The frozen digest of the interface at that minor.

items.description: A shipped piece this package replaces, by its exact name; a bare name of its own in the lists below passes only when listed here.
An event kind the plug-in adds.

A check kind the plug-in adds.
